Name: Chest and Minifridges as Japanese-ish Bamboo Baskets
Author: Asterisk555
Description:
[center]Retextures chests and mini-fridges to look like baskets, with a kind of visual labelling system as well as multiple colors

All items are individually tagged to make searching with Alternative Textures easier![/center]


[u]Quick start[/u]
[list=1]
[*]Download and extract this mod and it's requirements into your mods folder (if you are confused check out [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]this guide[/url]﻿).[/*]
[*]It's ready to play[/*]
[*]To re-texture items using AT, go to Robin's shop and buy the paint bucket.[/*]
[*]For the content patcher version, I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to choose your style.[/*]
[/list]
[u]Compatibility[/u]
[list]
[*]Should have very little to worry about compatibility wise. You can have multiple AT mods editing chests.[/*]
[*]For the CP version, if you have multiple mods trying to change how the chest looks then you might have some visual bugs.[/*]
[/list]
Video on how to use AT in-game:
[youtube]OzCzEppsXVY[/youtube]

[u]Credits[/u]
[list]
[*]All items with (VT) next to their name are made using sprites from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10852]Vanilla Tweaks[/url]﻿, so this mod has visual compatibility with that one![/*]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: @AllChestsAT Adds AT textures as options to all chests and the minifridge.

@CP version, only has covered baskets but the lids can change color. Recommended for use with the AT version, but is a good standalone option. Now has a config so you can use it with all, any, or none of the chests.
